annotation.title_clean: Joint call by the United Nations Secretary-General and the President of the International Committee of the Red Cross for States to establish new prohibitions and restrictions on Autonomous Weapon Systems
annotation.title_en: Joint call by the United Nations Secretary-General and the President of the International Committee of the Red Cross for States to establish new prohibitions and restrictions on Autonomous Weapon Systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC); United Nations Secretary-General
annotation.summary_en: Joint appeal by the UN Secretary-General and ICRC President urging States to negotiate a new legally binding instrument prohibiting unpredictable autonomous weapon systems and restricting others, preserving human control over use of force, concluding negotiations by 2026.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for a legally binding instrument on autonomous weapons, concluded by 2026
Prohibit autonomous weapons whose effects cannot be predicted, including machine-learning-controlled ones
Prohibit autonomous targeting of humans by machines
Restrict use by place, time, duration, target types and scale of force
Ensure effective human supervision, timely intervention and deactivation
